prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / 政策与工程治理方案段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。”。请严格按照 `BP37` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L007`（因果机制链 vs. 表面相关性切分（Causality vs. Correlation）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.
structural_constraints: S1 [对策总起句 Targeted Solution Thesis]：Mitigating [Problem X] effectively requires coordinated intervention across both [Level A: Technical/Curriculum Design] and [Level B: Institutional Governance].

S2 [对策 1：操作层可验证改革 Actionable Measure 1]：First, [Specific Actor 1, e.g., university departments] should replace [Vulnerable Practice] with [Verifiable Mechanism, e.g., oral defense and in-class iterative drafting], ensuring that [Specific Effect 1].

S3 [对策 2：制度/标准层激励对齐 Actionable Measure 2]：Concurrently, [Specific Actor 2, e.g., regulatory agencies / industry consortia] must establish [Concrete Standard, e.g., mandatory provenance watermarking and audit logs] to penalize [Misconduct].
S4 [协同闭环效果 Combined Outcome]：Together, aligning pedagogical verification with technical traceability curbs misuse without stifling legitimate innovation.

domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: Normal diffusion guidance makes the generated time series look unnatural when we add constraints. So we put the constraint inside the flow matching model, and it generates realistic samples in only 4 steps.
structural_constraints: S1 [权衡定性主题句 Asymmetry Thesis]：Weighing both dimensions reveals that the long-term structural benefits of [X] far outweigh its manageable transitional costs.

S2 [将弊端限定为可收敛成本 Bounding the Drawback]：While [Drawback A, e.g., initial capital outlay / training overhead] poses a tangible hurdle, this cost is bounded and diminishes rapidly as [Mitigating Factor, e.g., hardware amortization / open-source standardization] matures.

S3 [凸显优势的不可替代性 Highlighting Irreversible Gain]：By contrast, the core advantage—[Benefit B, e.g., eliminating human exposure to hazardous environments / discovering non-linear scientific laws]—delivers compounding value that manual methods cannot replicate at any cost.
S4 [权衡结论 Trade-off Verdict]：Therefore, addressing the friction through targeted safeguards is far more rational than forgoing the transformative gain.
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task1_Dynamic 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT13 (雅思小作文（Task 1）动态多折线图满分范文：四国清洁能源与煤炭发电占比 25 年演进及主次反转)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP25 -> BP26 -> BP32`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.
structural_constraints: S1 [对策总起句 Targeted Solution Thesis]：Mitigating [Problem X] effectively requires coordinated intervention across both [Level A: Technical/Curriculum Design] and [Level B: Institutional Governance].

S2 [对策 1：操作层可验证改革 Actionable Measure 1]：First, [Specific Actor 1, e.g., university departments] should replace [Vulnerable Practice] with [Verifiable Mechanism, e.g., oral defense and in-class iterative drafting], ensuring that [Specific Effect 1].

S3 [对策 2：制度/标准层激励对齐 Actionable Measure 2]：Concurrently, [Specific Actor 2, e.g., regulatory agencies / industry consortia] must establish [Concrete Standard, e.g., mandatory provenance watermarking and audit logs] to penalize [Misconduct].
